title: v3 texture pipeline audit: retained stages, opaque composition, small ROI resize
body: The compared v3 is concatenation of cached outputs from three historical scene runs, not the later padding/PNG experiment. ROI sizes: 762x294->760x288, 678x294->672x288, 820x294->816x288; maximum-side960 did not cause large downscale. restore_inference_region is unchanged and uses Lanczos only on mismatch, then RGB-lossless intermediate. composite_masked is unchanged, opaque RGB maskedmerge with no feather/blur, followed by CRF16/YUV420. Scene2 inference hides a constant627x100 band in43 frames, no entirely empty reference mask. All three scenes retain input/ROI/upstream-MP4/native/output/masks. Upstream MP4 already uses imageio quality9; no historical pre-codec tensor/PNG checkpoint, so network vs upstream encoding cannot be isolated perfectly without rerun. Phase1-b retained lossless candidate and exports, but review recorded persistent soft cloth and local buckle regression. Code presence does not certify deployment; no remote state was queried. Causal priority remains hypothesis until stage measurements.
